blocks.text:
Transform your outdoor furniture with the power of STAR BRITE Outdoor Furniture Cleaner Spray. This 32-ounce bottle is expertly formulated to tackle even the most stubborn dirt and grease across a variety of surfaces, including poly, resin, vinyl, plastic, rubber, glass, metal, and fiberglass. The ideal formula penetrates deep into dirt and grime, revitalizing your outdoor furniture with minimal effort. Simply spray the cleaner directly onto the surface, spread it evenly with a sponge or cloth, and allow it to work for 30 seconds before wiping clean. For tougher stains, a repeat application might be necessary, ensuring thorough cleaning and rejuvenation of your outdoor living space. This cleaner is designed to be a conscientious choice for maintaining your home's outdoor spaces. Elevate the look of your outdoor area with STAR BRITE Outdoor Furniture Cleaner, the perfect solution for keeping your furniture in pristine condition. For optimal results, follow up with the Outdoor Collection Furniture Protectant, ensuring your furniture remains protected from stains and sun for years to come.
 DIRECTIONS: Spray the Outdoor Collection Furniture Cleaner directly onto the surface to be cleaned. Use a sponge, cloth, or soft brush to spread the cleaner evenly. Allow it to work for 30 seconds before lightly brushing and rinsing or wiping clean. For stubborn stains, repeat the application, let it soak for about a minute, then lightly scrub and rinse or wipe clean.

items: POWERFUL CLEANING ACTION - Ideal formula that loosens and dissolves greasy, grimy messes on contact ensuring easy removal with minimal effort
MULTI-SURFACE FORMULA - Versatile cleaner suitable for poly, resin, vinyl, plastic, rubber, glass, metal, and fiberglass surfaces offering comprehensive cleaning for your entire outdoor space
IDEAL FOR STUBBORN STAINS - Effective on tough stains with the option for repeat applications to tackle the most persistent dirt and grime ensuring thorough cleaning
MAINTAIN YOUR OUTDOOR FURNITURE - Keeps your outdoor furniture looking like new, enhancing its longevity and maintaining its aesthetic appeal effortlessly
EASY TO USE - Simply spray on the surface, let it soak for a minute and rinse or wipe off off for instant cleanliness and shine
RECOMMENDED USE WITH PROTECTANT - For best results, follow up with Outdoor Collection Furniture Protectant to keep surfaces protected and looking their best
PROUDLY AMERICAN, TRUSTED GLOBALLY - With Star brite, you're choosing a leader in marine, auto, RV, home and outdoor products since 1973, all proudly made in the USA for superior quality
